channel.title: Joel Cook
channel.description: What I built, what it saved, and what broke along the way.

item.title: Consultants wanted $600,000 to sort our files
item.description: Years of misfiled documents, a move from Workday to Banner, and a quote with a lot of zeros. We passed, and I built the classifier myself.

item.title: 84% off the hosting bill, and it’s still too much
item.description: $50k became $8k for a site serving 250k visitors a month. Most people would take the win. I wanted to go further!

item.title: The morning our giving site became a casino
item.description: A phone call, a giving site turned casino, and an attacker who could still walk right back in after the patch.

item.title: Apparently, students do want a chatbot
item.description: $47k a year cheaper. More than 9,000 chats a week. And it all started with a bot that made students guess the magic words.
